answer: In an agent market coordinating walnut shipments from orchard to jetty, each agent must lock tokens in escrow to gain voting weight, and weight is proportional to the amount locked, not the number of accounts. Splitting one deposit among a thousand fake identities gives the attacker no extra influence. To control a vote, the attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens to outweigh honest participants, tying up capital for the escrow period.
